limits: Three zero-delay measured samples follow warm-up. Delay cases inject half the declared RTT before each outgoing online message; they do not emulate a real network.
Native timings do not predict Wasm or Cloudflare latency. Tables are read from local disk, not remote object storage.
The consuming handles enforce single use in memory. No durable pool, rollback protection, peer authentication, or admission is implemented.

sampler_evidence.scope: Disposable known rho-prime fixtures through real separate-role GC and OT. Every prefix, every candidate, output ownership, low-nibble order, and final bitmap padding are checked against an independent SHAKE oracle.

data.scope: Input-independent fresh garbling and random OT, followed by wallet-derived canonical keygen. Separate native roles, role-local disk tables, and private input correction. No production storage or hosted latency claim.
